answers.core: This is an enhancement to SceneTreeTimer which is a part of core. It would also be an incredibly minor change for an add-on.
answers.workaround:
I think the only way to work around this is to track all the delegates added (or at least potentially added) to a timer separately and then remove them. This could be done in a separate list, but that adds unnecessary complexity.

I tried working around this by directly freeing the timer, but that wasn't enough to stop the callback events from firing.

title: Add a method to clear Timeout handlers from SceneTreeTimer
